specification.objective: Keep the site-wide accessibility overlay's inherited MediaQuery live after mount so viewport, keyboard insets, platform text scaling, and reduced-motion changes propagate without resetting accessibility-tool state.

requirements.statement: When an ancestor MediaQuery changes after AccessibilityTools mounts, descendants in its retained overlay receive the new viewport size and viewInsets.
Platform text scaling changes propagate through the overlay and compose with the user's existing accessibility text-size adjustment.
Ancestor reduced-motion changes propagate through the overlay, while the AccessibilityTools state and open-panel/text-size preference remain intact.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A widget regression updates an ancestor MediaQuery after the overlay has mounted and asserts descendants see the new size and keyboard insets.
The same regression verifies a changed platform TextScaler composes with the retained 110% user setting, and checks the updated inherited disableAnimations value.
The panel remains open at 110% after the ancestor update, and the focused accessibility test suite passes.

invariants.statement: Do not change the overlay's intended position, accessibility controls, or behavior settings; make the inherited platform MediaQuery live inside the retained entry.
Do not change unrelated app overlays, dialogs, authentication flows, or workspace layouts.

forbidden_states.statement: The retained overlay uses a MediaQuery snapshot captured at initial build after an ancestor size, viewInsets, text-scaling, or reduced-motion update.
Refreshing inherited MediaQuery values discards the user's text-size setting or closes the accessibility panel.

inputs.statement: The live inherited MediaQuery supplied by MaterialApp and the active platform viewport/keyboard/accessibility settings.
AccessibilityTools' existing text-size, reduced-motion, and panel-open state.

outputs.statement: Overlay descendants receive current inherited media values while accessibility-tool preferences remain composed and intact.

failure_semantics.statement: On the locked baseline the focused regression fails with the literal reason accessibility_overlay_keeps_live_media_query; missing dependencies or a test-discovery error are not valid Red evidence.

argv: accessibility overlay follows ancestor media query changes while retaining state
accessibility overlay follows ancestor media query changes while retaining state
